tei:div.tei:head: Blessings of the New Month
tei:div.tei:note: The following prayer יְהִי רָצוֹן , composed by Rav, head of the Babylonian yeshiva at Sura, is mentioned in the Talmud, ( Maseches Berachos 16b), but not as a prayer specifically ordained for blessing the new month. It was actually a daily prayer that Rav recited each day after the regular service.

The יְהִי רָצוֹן was adapted by Ashkenazi Jews as a prayer for the coming of the new month by adding the words: שֶׁתְּחַדֵשׁ עָלֵינוּ אֶת הַחוֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה לְטוֹבָה וְלִבְרָכָה but Sephardic Jews omit the entire prayer as it is not mentioned either by Rambam or Avudraham.
